moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-blinds, written here): 7 vertical slats of equal width; slat i (left to right) starts at i x 50 ms and opens its width 0 -> full from its left edge over 400 ms easeOutCubic, revealing the incoming scene; ~700 ms total. HF showcase-cover ships horizontal and vertical blinds (Apache-2.0). Params: slats (7) · stagger (50 ms) · duration mỗi thanh (0.4 s).
